E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lost Our Lisa: Lisa's museum visit plans are ruined when Bart glues novelty items to his face. So she decides to go alone on the bus, but ends up on the wrong side of town... (S9 Ep24/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Kicks: Peralta looks for a loophole to get out of desk duty. Diaz thinks Pimento is cheating on her. (S5 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: HalloVeen: The squad embark on their fifth annual Halloween Heist. Everybody has a plan, no one is safe, and relationships and friendships are sorely tested. (S5 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family

E4Plus1.uk.description: Good Cop Bad Dog: Phil and Claire swap parenting roles for the day - Claire will be the fun-loving good cop and Phil the disciplinarian bad cop. (S2 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The One That Got Away: Jay wants a quiet birthday fishing on the lake, but the family think he wants a big celebration. (S2 Ep24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Big Fat Geek Wedding: On the eve of their nuptials, Edna calls it all off with Principal Skinner. As Marge consoles Edna, she realises her own relationship isn't so great. (S15 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Catch 'Em if You Can: Homer and Marge abscond for a romantic weekend in Miami, so Bart and Lisa chase them across the country to ruin their holiday. (S15 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.description: The Kara-te Kid: Inspired by the Karate Kid films, Adam and the other Adam Goldberg face off in a karate match to settle their long-running feud for good. (S4 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.description: Greg and Larry: The squad drop everything when they realise that Holt is in danger as the search for Pimento's hitman takes an unexpected turn. (S3 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Chef Anthony stresses over preparing an eight-course meal with an array of dietary requirements. Barbara and Jess talk about their future away from the yacht. (S12 Ep15)
